items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Uh, Gahir, eh? They had two different guys? Yeah, they had two different guys. Yeah, so he got killed quite naturally in Sidney, and he knew he took his place.

ctx.x: And before, when something went wrong with the machine, you told about the guy that got killed playing banjo.
Uh, Gahir, eh? They had two different guys? Yeah, they had two different guys. Yeah, so he got killed quite naturally in Sidney, and he knew he took his place. Yeah.
They had a lot of guys that played there. I know Danny Barker used to be there, and John L. Jones, a different town.
